subject: maths
question: The compound interest on Rs. 1,00,000 at 25% per annum for 2 years compounded annually is:
solution: Given: Principal = Rs. 1,00,000 Rate = 25% Time = 2 years Formula used: (i) A = P{1 + (r/100)}t Where, A = amount P = principal r = rate t = time
